en.title: Computer {{Science}} Degree
en.text: Graduated with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. Focus areas included [[software engineering]], algorithms, database systems, and web development. Final thesis on building a scalable RESTful API service.

es.title: Licenciatura en {{Ciencias de la Computación}}
es.text: Graduado con Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación. Áreas de enfoque: [[ingeniería de software]], algoritmos, sistemas de bases de datos y desarrollo web.

fr.title: Licence en {{Informatique}}
fr.text: Diplômé avec une licence en informatique. Domaines d'intérêt : [[génie logiciel]], algorithmes, systèmes de bases de données et développement web.

ko.title: 컴퓨터 {{과학}} 학사
ko.text: 컴퓨터 과학 학사 졸업. [[소프트웨어 공학]], 알고리즘, 데이터베이스 시스템, 웹 개발에 집중. 확장 가능한 RESTful API 서비스 구축에 관한 졸업 논문.

en.title: {{Junior}} Rails Developer
en.text: Started my Rails career building internal tools and [[client-facing web apps]]. Worked on a multi-tenant SaaS platform handling billing, user management, and email notification workflows.

es.title: Desarrollador Rails {{Junior}}
es.text: Comencé mi carrera en Rails construyendo herramientas internas y [[aplicaciones web para clientes]]. Trabajé en una plataforma SaaS multi-tenant con facturación, gestión de usuarios y flujos de notificación por email.

fr.title: Développeur Rails {{Junior}}
fr.text: Début de ma carrière Rails en développant des outils internes et des [[applications web client]]. Travail sur une plateforme SaaS multi-tenant gérant la facturation, la gestion des utilisateurs et les workflows de notification par email.

ko.title: {{주니어}} Rails 개발자
ko.text: 내부 도구와 [[고객용 웹앱]] 구축으로 Rails 커리어를 시작. 결제, 사용자 관리, 이메일 알림 워크플로우를 처리하는 멀티테넌트 SaaS 플랫폼에서 작업.

en.title: {{Backend}} Developer
en.text: Joined ZigExn Vietnam to work on high-traffic recruitment platforms. Responsible for [[API design and optimization]], background job architecture with Sidekiq, and database performance tuning for millions of job listings.

es.title: Desarrollador {{Backend}}
es.text: Me uní a ZigExn Vietnam para trabajar en plataformas de reclutamiento de alto tráfico. Responsable del [[diseño y optimización de APIs]], arquitectura de trabajos en segundo plano con Sidekiq y ajuste del rendimiento de bases de datos.

fr.title: Développeur {{Backend}}
fr.text: Rejoint ZigExn Vietnam pour travailler sur des plateformes de recrutement à fort trafic. Responsable de la [[conception et l'optimisation des API]], l'architecture des tâches en arrière-plan avec Sidekiq et l'optimisation des performances de la base de données.

ko.title: {{백엔드}} 개발자
ko.text: 고트래픽 채용 플랫폼 작업을 위해 ZigExn Vietnam 합류. [[API 설계 및 최적화]], Sidekiq을 활용한 백그라운드 작업 아키텍처, 수백만 개의 채용 공고에 대한 데이터베이스 성능 튜닝 담당.

en.title: {{Senior}} Rails Developer
en.text: Promoted to Senior Developer, leading a team of 4 engineers. Key responsibilities include:
list: Architecting new microservices using Rails API mode
Mentoring junior and mid-level developers
Driving Rails upgrade initiatives (6.x → 7.x)
Designing scalable background job systems with Sidekiq
Code review standards and CI/CD pipeline improvements

list: Arquitectura de nuevos microservicios usando el modo API de Rails
Mentoría de desarrolladores junior y de nivel medio
Iniciativas de actualización de Rails (6.x → 7.x)

Estándares de revisión de código y mejoras de pipeline CI/CD

ko.text: 시니어 개발자로 승진, 4명의 엔지니어 팀을 이끌고 있습니다. 주요 책임:
list: Rails API 모드를 사용한 새로운 마이크로서비스 아키텍처 설계
주니어 및 중급 개발자 멘토링
